commands.mutation: writes receipt and output artifacts only under the controller workspace; foreign target state is observed before and after
appends a repair plan, attempt, replacement packet, and receipt lineage when authorized by the active execution
creates one new exact-byte offline bundle and refuses overwrite
imports exact receipt bytes idempotently and refuses byte conflicts

compatibility.policy: N verifies N and declared N-1 producer identities; N-1 is not required to trust an undeclared future producer identity

privacy.defaultNetworkRequestsScope: RunKit control plane only; a captured or replayed child command is caller-owned, unrestricted, and unmeasured

metrics.statement: Local totals describe project receipt state; independent consumption is evidenced by caller-owned attestation results, never hidden instrumentation.

issueCodes.ACCEPTED_AUTHORITY_GRANTED: A Formal bundle marked accepted while its closeout grants authority.
issueCodes.ACCEPTED_RECEIPT_NOT_PASSED: A Formal bundle marked accepted while its active receipt did not pass.
issueCodes.ACTIVE_RECEIPT_CONTEXT_BINDING_MISMATCH: The active Formal receipt context does not match the declared verification context.
issueCodes.ACTIVE_RECEIPT_SOURCE_BINDING_MISMATCH: The active Formal receipt source does not match the declared source fingerprint.
issueCodes.CANONICAL_JSON_INVALID: Canonical JSON computation failed at a public Formal artifact boundary.
issueCodes.CLOSEOUT_ACTIVE_RECEIPT_MISMATCH: The Formal closeout does not bind the active receipt.
issueCodes.CLOSEOUT_CONTEXT_BINDING_MISMATCH: The Formal closeout context does not bind the declared verification context.
issueCodes.CLOSEOUT_SOURCE_BINDING_MISMATCH: The Formal closeout source does not bind the declared source fingerprint.
issueCodes.DUPLICATE_OBJECT_KEY: A Formal JSON input contains a duplicate object key.
issueCodes.EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_GRANTED: A public Formal bundle attempts to grant external authority.
issueCodes.INPUT_FILE_INVALID: A Formal verifier input file cannot be read under the public file boundary.
issueCodes.INPUT_JSON_INVALID: A Formal verifier input is not strict valid JSON.
issueCodes.INPUT_SIZE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: A Formal verifier input exceeds the deterministic byte limit.
issueCodes.JSON_NESTING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: A Formal verifier input exceeds the deterministic nesting limit.
issueCodes.JSON_NODE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: A Formal verifier input exceeds the deterministic JSON node limit.
issueCodes.PUBLIC_BUNDLE_SHAPE_INVALID: A Formal public bundle has an unknown, missing, or extra field.
issueCodes.RECEIPT_AUTHORITY_GRANTED: A Formal receipt attempts to grant external authority.
issueCodes.RECEIPT_COUNT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: A Formal bundle exceeds the deterministic receipt-count limit.
issueCodes.RECEIPT_ID_DUPLICATE: A Formal receipt identifier appears more than once.
issueCodes.RECEIPT_LINEAGE_CYCLE: Formal replacement lineage contains a cycle.
issueCodes.RECEIPT_LINEAGE_MULTIPLE_ACTIVE_LEAVES: Formal replacement lineage has more than one active leaf.
issueCodes.RECEIPT_LINEAGE_NO_ACTIVE_LEAF: Formal replacement lineage has no active leaf.
issueCodes.RECEIPT_LINEAGE_ORPHAN: A Formal replacement references a parent absent from earlier append-only lineage.
issueCodes.SOURCE_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH: The Formal source payload does not match its declared fingerprint.
issueCodes.VERIFICATION_CONTEXT_FINGERPRINT_MISMATC: The Formal verification context does not match its declared fingerprint.
issueCodes.anchor_absent: No external checkpoint or timestamp anchor was checked; unsigned V1 remains usable under local policy.
issueCodes.attestation_material_missing: A receipt-bound output material is unavailable, so the result is indeterminate rather than silently accepted.
issueCodes.attestation_target_ambiguous: More than one byte-distinct local receipt matches the reference.
issueCodes.attestation_target_not_found: No receipt matching the exact local reference was found in the supplied stores.
issueCodes.bound_ignored_path_mutated_during_verifi: An explicitly bound ignored workspace path changed while the command ran.
issueCodes.consumer_source_mutated_during_verificat: The exact command changed Git-visible source in the disposable consumer.
issueCodes.core_identity_mismatch: The receipt producer Core identity is not declared by this verifier.
issueCodes.current_workspace_not_checked: No explicit workspace was selected, so Quick attestation did not read output paths or compare current checkout bytes.
issueCodes.dependency_environment_mutated_during_ve: Bound dependency resolution metadata changed while the command ran.
issueCodes.quick_ignored_artifact_unbound: Git-ignored outputs are not bound unless an explicit artifact contract names and hashes them.
issueCodes.quick_isolation_cleanup_failed: The disposable consumer could not be removed after verification.
issueCodes.quick_receipt_store_invalid: The project-local receipt store failed its path or file integrity boundary.
issueCodes.receipt_duplicate_key: The receipt contains a duplicate JSON object key.
issueCodes.receipt_dependency_environment_mismatch: Current bound dependency metadata differs from the receipt.
issueCodes.receipt_material_hash_mismatch: A receipt-bound material differs from its recorded bytes, hash, or size.
issueCodes.receipt_schema_invalid: The receipt does not satisfy the strict supported schema.
issueCodes.receipt_source_mismatch: The selected workspace source does not match the receipt-bound source.
issueCodes.repair_plan_incomplete: A deterministic repair plan cannot safely replay every required command and binding.
issueCodes.repair_replay_failed: A replay command failed; the failed attempt and earlier lineage remain append-only.
issueCodes.signature_absent: No receipt signature is present or checked; this is expected under unsigned V1 and proves no signer identity.
issueCodes.source_mutated_during_verification: Source bytes changed while the command was running.
issueCodes.verification_command_failed: The captured verification command did not exit successfully.
issueCodes.verification_context_mismatch: The current runtime context differs from the receipt-bound runtime context.
issueCodes.foreign_workspace_mutated_during_verific: The governed foreign target state changed while its isolated verification command ran.

integration.persist: OwlCodaAttestationRefV1 plus the referenced receipt bytes
integration.consume: attest or resolve through a declared command or the standalone package
integration.futureSignedProfile: additive; producer command and AttestationRefV1 shape remain unchanged
